verdict.rationale: ADP's API Central offers OAuth 2.0 programmatic access so developers can 'automate HR processes through integration', which amounts to UI-less operation. The evidence never ties API Central to RUN specifically, it is a separately purchased add-on, and nothing shows CLI or CI-runner usage. missing for 10: explicit RUN coverage by the API, CLI/SDK for headless execution, documented CI/pipeline usage, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: developers to automate HR processes through integration for accurate, real-time data sharing, eliminating file-based imports and exports.
API Central leverages OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 authentication and authorization to ensure only authorized users and systems can access the data
API Central can be purchased online and digitally activated within minutes.
